name: – After § 1 – Am 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
part_text: 1c. Calls on the Commission and the Member States to fully and consistently apply Council Regulation (EC) No 2271/96 and all relevant EU instruments in order to prevent any alignment by the EU and its economic operators with the United States’ unilateral and extraterritorial sanctions against Cuba, and to ensure that no European company is compelled to interrupt or reduce its legitimate commercial, financial or investment relations with the island as a consequence of such measures;
